span.p: 独立物理更新流程

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FixedUpdate 开始
固定物理更新

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Player → PlayerIntentManager
刷新控制许可

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Player → 下身状态机
物理步推进（FixedTick）读取移动计划
ReadState.Locomotion.Plan

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
下身状态机 → CapsuleCollider（胶囊碰撞体）
调整站蹲碰撞体，回写实际姿态

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
下身状态机 → Rigidbody（刚体）
执行位移与转向

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 本次物理步结束

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Update 开始
每帧逻辑更新

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PlayerInput → InputIntentProcessor
采样输入、写入黑板并刷新许可

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PlayerViewController
通过意图管理器更新观察角
读取观察与相机分类（ReadState.View）
提交视角节点

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PlayerCameraController
通过意图管理器处理滚轮缩放

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PlayerEquipment
同步当前装备与 Weapon

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Player → 上身状态机 / Weapon
刷新许可，读取输入 / 武器分类（Input / Weapon）
推进武器与上身状态

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
上身状态机 → PlayerIntentManager
写入上身需求、动作与表现状态

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Player → PlayerIntentManager
合并输入、上身需求与站蹲约束，生成移动计划

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Player → 下身状态机
读取移动分类（ReadState.Locomotion）中的计划
切换状态并更新下身动画

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Player → PlayerAimPose / PlayerWeaponRig
读取姿态 / 武器分类（Pose / Weapon）
提交瞄准姿态与武器绑定（Rig）

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Player → 上身状态机 → PlayerWeaponPresentation
读取武器 / 移动分类（Weapon / Locomotion）
同步上身动画

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
LateUpdate 开始
每帧后期更新

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PlayerInput / PlayerViewController
刷新许可、修正视角节点

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PlayerCameraController
通过意图管理器处理相机目标
读取观察与相机分类（ReadState.View）中的参数
交由 Cinemachine 相机系统跟随

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PlayerEquipment / PlayerInteraction
同步装备；读取交互分类（Interaction）
检测并执行交互，通过输入宿主（PlayerInput）回报目标

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Player 检查
是否需要取消武器动作？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Player → 上身状态机
取消动作，同步双状态机与姿态表现

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 本帧流程结束
